profile.policy: Whole profiler interval weights; boundary intervals retained. Exclusive leaves and inclusive ancestors are distinct; inclusive recursion counts each complete frame at most once per sample. Unmapped Wasm names remain unresolved. These are sampled elapsed intervals, not continuously measured CPU time. Inspector and hrtime clocks are not aligned for clipping.

counters.boundary: Identical frozen native-final Scheme module and provider; JS wrappers replace its direct scalar imports. Scalar call counts do not estimate production linked-machine-call overhead.

gc.policy: Observed events overlap the workload clock; whole event durations retained at boundaries. Occurrence and delivery timestamps are distinct. A missing event record is unavailable, not zero GC. Default heap policy. GC duration excludes mutator allocation, rooting, barriers and Rust allocator work; host activity was not quiet.

native.scope: Unchanged frozen native binary; SNAIL_GC_STATS enables collection-phase clocks only. Whole process includes initialization and setup. Counts are native Scheme managed objects and requested bytes, not Rust allocations, V8 allocations, RSS or worker-only counts. Default collection policy retained.
